evidence.excerpt:
## Run Petclinic locally

Spring Petclinic is a [Spring Boot](https://spring.io/guides/gs/spring-boot) application built using [Maven](https://spring.io/guides/gs/maven/) or [Gradle](https://spring.io/guides/gs/gradle/).
Java 17 or later is required for the build, and the application can run with Java 17 or newer.

You first need to clone the project locally:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-petclinic.git
cd spring-petclinic
```
If you are using Maven, you can start the application on the command-line as follows:

```bash
./mvnw spring-boot:run
```
With Gradle, the command is as follows:

```bash
./gradlew bootRun
```

You can then access the Petclinic at <http://localhost:8080/>.

questions.question: Where is searching owners by last-name prefix implemented? Name its component and definition.
questions.answer: OwnerController.processFindForm normalizes the surname and calls findPaginatedForOwnersLastName. The helper requests a five-entry page from OwnerRepository.findByLastNameStartingWith. The interface documents prefix semantics; actual query implementation is a Spring Data runtime boundary.

questions.question: Which internal components does OwnerController directly use in owner search, and what proves each direction?

questions.question: For GET /owners?lastName=Franklin&page=1, give the source-supported call/dispatch path to its outcome; identify dynamic or unresolved boundaries.
questions.answer: MVC mapping/binding -> processFindForm -> findPaginatedForOwnersLastName -> OwnerRepository.findByLastNameStartingWith. The name is stripped and the helper uses PageRequest.of(0,5). Zero results return findOwners with notFound; one redirects to owner ID; multiple populate pagination and return ownersList. MVC binding, generated JPA query, database result count and rendering are runtime boundaries; this is not an executed request trace.

questions.question: Where does the lastName HTTP query value enter and get handled or transformed?
questions.answer: MVC binds request data to the Owner parameter of processFindForm. The handler reads getLastName, maps null to empty string and otherwise strips whitespace. It passes the normalized surname to the paginated prefix repository query; framework binding is not an explicit repository-local call.
